# R5.19 — Prepared gateway reservations and persistent deadline (seq 189)

Implements contract `docs/tickets/189_R5.19__gateway.md`, **as amended
2026-11-03** by the scoped split review — verdict **AMEND** (ruling
commit `4ec29023`; review record
`docs/build/planning/2026-11-03_R5.19-split-review.md`). Offline-only;
USD 0; merges OPERATOR.

**Deviation (conspicuous):** 1,933 changed source/test lines vs the
≤1000 split trigger (~1.93×). The worker stopped correctly at the
trigger (checkpoint `8c9546e8`); the scoped review found the
retained-view→wire ordering is one admitted atomic unit — Packet B
B.1 item 5 fixes the whole order and B.2 binds it to ONE gateway
seam/owner, the proposed prepare/dispatch cut splits AC-1/AC-2
mid-predicate (prepare refusals verify only via zero dispatch;
dispatch refusals need a prepared artifact; B.5 retry-reservation
spans both), and leg (b) ~1,230 would still exceed the trigger.
Accepted as a recorded Deviation per the Amended 2026-11-03 ruling —
never a precedent for unmeasured growth.

## What changed

- `crates/hh-gateway/src/prepared.rs` (new, 1,013 lines) —
  `PreparedCall`: the admitted fixed order **retained view → existing
  serialization + primary bounds → whole-vector Account reservation →
  sealed provider plan → durable request → deadline-bounded dispatch →
  durable actual/unknown usage → charge/release**.
  - `prepare(...)`: serializes the owned `retained_selection/1`
    member through the existing canonical codec (`view_bytes` +
    `view_ref` idp address — consumed unchanged) → bounds every
    admitted input/output role and overhead (five token primaries +
    `model_calls` required ≥ 1; `retries`/`time.wall_ms` admitted
    when declared; `codec::estimate_tokens` input floor;
    `tokens.*.total` stay derived, never charged) → whole-vector
    `Account::reserve` (R5.12 consumed unchanged; `Unfunded` is a
    typed pre-dispatch refusal) → sealed plan carrying
    `budget_reservation_id` → `request_bytes` + `request_ref`
    (`InvalidPlan`/`CredentialUnavailable` through the admitted
    ports) → created-origin deadline `created_at_ms` + tightest
    path `time.wall_ms` hard cap, one function of durable inputs —
    identical across resume/approval/drain, never session
    arithmetic (`OriginMissing`/`UntrustworthyOrigin`/
    `DeadlineExpired` typed).
  - `dispatch(...)`: re-derived deadline → sealed-byte verify
    (`PreparedBytesMutated` — the presented plan must serialize to
    exactly the sealed request) → outstanding-reservation check
    (`MissingReservation` — an unfunded call dispatches zero) →
    durable `model.call.requested` once per `model_call_id`
    (`view_hash`/`plan_hash`/`request_ref`/
    `budget_reservation_id`/`token_estimate`) → `run_attempts` over
    the prepared bytes reusing the same reservation (B.5), each
    attempt deadline-gated → durable `model.call.attempt.*` +
    terminal `model.call.completed{usage{available,record}}` /
    `model.call.failed{error{…}}` — `timeout{…}` stays `timeout{…}`
    (never remote cancellation), the deadline stop is a genuine
    local `cancelled`, served-model drift under
    `substitution_allowed=false` → `failed{served_model_mismatch}` →
    `Account::charge` per admitted primary with `reservation_id` +
    terminal `EventRef` source (landed `(source, dim)` dedup) /
    `release` remainder / expiry drain. Absent usage stays unknown
    exposure, never zero; a release never refunds physical use.
  - Typed alphabet: `PrepareRefusal` ×10, `DispatchVerdict` ×7 —
    every refusal dispatches zero bytes and mints no call rows.
- `crates/hh-gateway/tests/r5_19.rs` (new, 919 lines) — the nine-test
  battery (fails-without: `hharness_gateway::prepared` is compile-red
  at base `5caeb304`); `Store::open_with` + `ManualClock` for the
  resume/approval/expiry legs; a capturing `Transport` records the
  dispatched bytes.
- `crates/hh-gateway/src/lib.rs` — module export (+1).
- `docs/adr/ADR-0397` — the owned landing decisions (staged-call
  shape, bound vocabulary, reservation-in-plan, created-origin
  deadline, minted members, reconcile semantics, refusal/verdict
  alphabet); ADR index + REVISIT_TRIGGERS regenerated; BACKLOG.csv
  BL-47 sources home.
- `docs/build/planning/2026-10-30_evidence-coverage.md` — dated
  contributing note names seq 189 (AC-3).
- `docs/build/runs/R5.19.md` — run ledger (gate verbatim, guard
  reads, cap-trigger STOP + `4ec29023` ruling, evidence).

| AC | Verdict | Evidence |

| AC-1 (D/E; positive) | met | r5_19 ac1_* ×2 — retained view → canonical `view_ref`; whole-vector `reserved{held}` names every admitted primary; sealed plan carries `budget_reservation_id`; `model.call.requested` once (view_hash/plan_hash/request_ref) → bounded attempts → `completed{usage{available,record}}`; charge lands once per primary with `reservation_id`; deadline = `created_at_ms` + tightest wall cap, identical across ManualClock resume/approval and committed drain |
| AC-2 (D/E; negative) | met | r5_19 ac2_* ×7 — `Unbounded`/`UnadmittedBound`/`Underbounded`/`Unfunded` dispatch zero (`reserved{refused}` only); `PreparedBytesMutated` sends nothing; `timeout{…}` verbatim never cancelled + retries reuse the reservation; `usage{available:false}` = unknown exposure never zero; `served_model_mismatch`; release after real spend creates no physical capacity |
| AC-3 (D/E; ownership/evidence) | met | coverage dated contributing note (seq 189) maps REQ-E-207/REQ-E-006/REQ-D-006 + aliases REQ-E-005/105/106 to §2 + dossier B.9 checks 3–4 and `tests/r5_19.rs`; achieved engineered D/E recorded separately from owed R/P + actual-execution E; contributor evidence consumed — no full-target claim |
